description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Debtors' Transport, adding {C}{C}.
When Debtors' Transport dies, its afterlife ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Debtors' Transport trigger, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Debtors' Transport from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
